A.name: Steel & Blink
A.summary: Reaper expand into a 2-1-1 Stim + 2 Medivac timing, while your ally takes a fast Nexus into Blink Stalkers. Hit the greedier opponent together at 6:00, then macro to three bases. This is the plan you default to when scouting shows nothing scary.

B.name: Shock Protocol
B.summary: Both players stay on one base and hit at 4:45 with ~20 stimmed Marines and 8-12 warped Gateway units. Punishes any team that takes a fast third, opens Stargate, or forgets static defense. Semi all-in: you can expand behind it if the first wave trades well.

C.name: Door Kick
C.summary: Pure cheese. Both players proxy and arrive at the closer enemy at 2:40 with Marines, Zealots and workers. Wins on the spot against anyone who did not scout or wall; loses outright to a good hold. Use sparingly and never on maps with long rush paths.
C.title: Proxy 2-Rax

D.name: Siege Wall
D.summary: The most defensively solid plan. You open Reaper FE into Tanks on two bases; your ally takes a fast Nexus into Robo Immortals and Sentries. You hold every early timing behind a Bunker, batteries and a sieged Tank, then walk across the map at 6:15 with 4 Tanks, +1 Marines, 3 Immortals and Guardian Shield.

E.name: Long Game
E.summary: You open Hellions and a Banshee for map control and harass, then turtle into Tanks, Thors and Hellbats on three bases. Your ally opens Oracle for harass and takes a third, then builds Carriers and Tempests with Archons. The classic 2v2 late-game army: almost nothing beats Tank/Thor + Carrier/Archon at 12 minutes if you get there with equal bases.

F.name: Reaction Protocol
F.summary: Run this alongside any plan. Each step is a scouting checkpoint with the reaction for both players. In 2v2 you are usually hit by the attack designed for your ally, so both of you read every checkpoint.
F.title: Terran checkpoints and reactions

steps.action: Pre-game: agree a plan and a proxy spot
steps.note: Say the plan letter and the hit time out loud. Decide who defends which base if bases are separate.
You do not SCV-scout; the Reaper does it. Ask the ally for Gateway / Barracks / Pool count.
Missing Barracks/Gateway at home = proxy. No natural by 2:00 + 2 gas = one-base tech or all-in.
Bunker at the top of your ramp NOW (100 min), finish the wall, pull 4 SCVs to repair. Delay the CC; keep building Marines. Ally: Shield Battery + Stalker, Probes on hold position at the ramp.
Count: 3+ Gateways on one base = 4-gate at 4:30. 3 Barracks = 3-rax at 4:30. Stargate = Oracle at 3:50. Fast Hatch + Pool + 2 gas = Roach/Ravager at 4:30-5:30.
Engineering Bay now, Turret in each mineral line by 3:45, 1 Marine squad at home. Ally: Stalker + Battery per mineral line.

Bunker #2 at the natural, Siege Tank from the Factory, keep 2 Medivacs home. Ally: 3 Batteries at the natural, no Nexus #3 until 6:00. The 4:30 hit dies to Bunker + Tank + Batteries if nobody wanders.
One scan at 4:00 and one at 5:30. Tell the ally where it is.

Siege a Tank behind the Bunker, pull SCVs to repair the Bunker, Widow Mine at the ramp. Ally: Force Field the ramp, Immortals target Roaches / Tanks. Never fight sieged Tanks in the open; counter-drop instead.
Turret in each mineral line + 1 at the Tank line, keep 50 energy for a scan. Ally: Observer at home, Oracle Revelation.
Turrets up, Thor or Marines on hold at the mineral lines, Vikings if they go Corruptor. Ally: Phoenix or Archons, Cannon + Battery per mineral line.
